periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation with the primary axis slanted downward toward the snout at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with the horizontal width significantly exceeding the vertical height.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced tapering at the inferior-medial boundary, creating a teardrop-shaped extension toward the muzzle.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal gap across the dorsal cranium, with the inter-ear distance roughly equivalent to the width of the skull's crown.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly convex and rounded curvature along the superior boundary of the pinnae.
